title: packet phase-slot Mirror head
hypothesis: One shared packet-token head plus small per-slot phase coordinates can recover four correlated future-token functions with lower actual payload than independent MTP heads while retaining joint packet accuracy and beating a low-rank PTP-style shared control.
mirror_coordinate: One learned Givens phase per future slot
logical_multiplicity: Four logical future-token slot functions from one physical head

development.selection_metric: joint slot NLL and exact packet accuracy after 500 Adam updates at LR 0.02

success_gate: On aligned fresh worlds, Mirror joint NLL <=1.10x MTP, exact packet accuracy within 0.01 of MTP, payload <=0.80x MTP and no larger than the rank-2 slot-code control. Report generated tokens/s. This is a synthetic packet mechanism gate only.
failure_gate: Both development worlds miss either quality/packet-consistency or actual-byte gates, or Mirror loses to the simple rank-2 shared control on both quality and bytes. Keep fresh worlds sealed after failure.
boundaries: Synthetic four-slot classification, not a language model
Aligned teacher uses per-slot Givens rotations
Sequential control has token feedback but no Transformer KV cache
